description: This file defines an in-memory fake implementation of the CalendarAccountRepository interface for testing purposes. It allows adding, querying, and clearing calendar account objects without interacting with a database.

classes.name: InMemoryCalendarAccountRepository
classes.description: A test double class that simulates account repository behavior in memory for unit testing.

methods.name: addAccount
methods.description: Adds a CalendarAccount object to the in-memory store. Throws an exception if the account ID is empty.

methods.name: getCalendarAccountsForUser
methods.description: Retrieves accounts matching optional filters such as user ID, type, validation status, and limit; mimics production query logic.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the in-memory accounts store, removing all stored accounts.
